row.proto: float Game_StatEvent_AccumulateStatValue(void *table, void *key, uint8_t statId, float value)
row.notes: Finds provider entry (0x18 stride, key = 3 bytes + int at +4) or appends one via Game_StatEvent_AppendProviderEntry, then updates stat slot statId (<0x27) in its block at +0x10: slot value at +8+id*0x10 is XOR-obfuscated with key at +0x10+id*0x10, bitset at +0 marks presence. First write sets, ids 0x23/0x25 keep max, 0x22 keeps min, others add. Good hook to observe telemetry stat writes.
